pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code?

```go
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	num1 := 2
	num2 := 3
	fmt.Println(num1 + num2)
}
```

topics.title: Modifying Strings
topics.description: Study concepts and solve targeted engineering problems for Modifying Strings.

pages.title: Multiple Choice Question
pages.content:
What will be the output of this code?

```go
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	s := "abc"
	runeSlice := []rune(s)
	runeSlice[2] = 'd'
	s = string(runeSlice)
	fmt.Println(s)
}


```

callout.title: Key takeaway
callout.text: Modifying Strings: focus on the Go syntax and runtime behavior demonstrated in this lesson.
